mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate lacosamide's CNS depressant effects and theoretically increase serotonergic activity, while lacosamide can prolong PR/QT intervals which may be exacerbated by MAOI-related cardiovascular effects.
action: Concurrent use requires careful monitoring; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible, ensure baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and watch for excessive CNS depression or serotonergic symptoms.
